source_locations: Lemma 3.24 and the proof of Theorem 1.9(ii)
note: The coefficient certificates were calculated from the exact shifted and diagonally normalized recurrence using the polynomial-Airy formal system explained in the report. The verifier independently substitutes the stored profiles into the recurrence and reconstructs the endpoint factors; it does not import a derivation script. Reference integers come from the defining prefix-sum recurrence and are recomputed by the verifier. Infinite-order analytic conclusions are supplied by the accompanying proof rather than by these finite checks.
